_note: MC/AUM ratio data from Yu, Zhao, Sui (2026) 'Paper Agents, Paper Gains' (arXiv:2605.29174). DeFi token prices from Crypto.com Exchange 2026-06-21; TVL figures are approximate public estimates for 2026-Q2. Circulating-supply estimates from public token-metrics disclosures.

ratios.label: AI agent tokens
ratios.ratioNote: Lower bound stated in the paper; individual projects exceed this. Aggregate MC peaked >$3B while typical per-project AUM (capital actively traded by the agent) was <$300k. The ratio is computed at the project level, not in aggregate.

ratios.label: Uniswap (UNI)
ratios.ratioNote: UNI MC ~$1.8B (≈600M circulating × $3.00); Uniswap all-versions TVL ~$4.5B. UNI is a pure governance token — the fee switch has not been activated, so there is no direct revenue link between protocol income and token price.

ratios.label: Hedge fund mgmt co.
ratios.ratioNote: Management company equity as a fraction of AUM: a $10B fund at 2% annual fee earns $200M/yr; at a 20× P/E the management business is worth $4B = 0.40× AUM. Fee income directly links the management company's value to assets under management.

ratios.label: Compound (COMP)
ratios.ratioNote: COMP MC ~$133M (≈7.5M circulating × $17.74); Compound V3 TVL ~$1.75B. COMP carries a fee-switch option — governance could activate revenue sharing — but no active revenue currently flows to token holders.

ratios.label: Aave (AAVE)
ratios.ratioNote: AAVE MC ~$1.13B (≈14.9M circulating × $75.71); Aave V3 TVL ~$24B. Protocol revenue flows to the safety module (stakers) and fee recipient — a partial revenue link anchors MC closer to TVL.

tiers.label: Top 1% of holders
tiers.note: Early buyers, insiders, and sophisticated traders who accumulated near launch and sold into the peak. The paper reports this cohort captured 81.4% of all gains distributed across the 925,323-holder sample.

tiers.label: Bottom 99% of holders
tiers.note: Computed: total net loss of all 925,323 holders (−$191.7M) minus top-1% gains (+$1.81B). Median returns were negative on every platform studied. Average token price declined 93% from ATH.
